fields.summary: No driver shall be on duty or operate a commercial motor vehicle while the driver possesses wine of not less than one-half of one per centum of alcohol by volume, beer as defined in 26 U.S.C. 5052(a) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954, or distilled spirits as defined in section 5002(a)(8) of such Code, except that this prohibition does not apply to possession of wine, beer, or distilled spirits that are manifested and transported as part of a shipment, or possessed or used by bus passengers.
fields.quote:
(3) Be on duty or operate a commercial motor vehicle while the driver possesses wine of not less than one-half of one per centum of alcohol by volume, beer as defined in 26 U.S.C. 5052(a), of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954, or distilled spirits as defined in section 5002(a)(8), of such Code. However, this does not apply to possession of wine, beer, or distilled spirits which are:

(i) Manifested and transported as part of a shipment; or

(ii) Possessed or used by bus passengers.
